description: Stage 4 of validation, the rules on findings and the access log: duplicates and the order of findings, tiers without an access, planned access without a plan, the order of access times and the basis of a support, each issue sorted by pointer, code and message.

cases.description: A finding of keys.duplicates repeated right after itself: E7001 at the later one, and no E7002, since an equal finding does not come before it.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/1 has the same check and scope as an earlier finding.

cases.description: structure.cluster_sizes before keys.duplicates: E7002 at the finding that comes before the one immediately before it.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/1 is not in the order of check and scope.

cases.description: keys.duplicates repeated at the end, after a finding of another check: E7001 for the repeat and E7002, since it also comes before the finding immediately before it.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/3 has the same check and scope as an earlier finding.
The finding at /findings/3 is not in the order of check and scope.

cases.description: Two findings of structure.cluster_sizes for the factors 'caf\u00e9' and 'cafe\u0301', which are equal after NFC: E7001.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/1 has the same check and scope as an earlier finding.

cases.description: Findings for the factors 'item' and 'Subject': E7002, since 'S' comes before 'i' in code-point order.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/1 is not in the order of check and scope.

cases.description: The same findings for 'Subject' and then 'item': in order, no issue.
Two findings of outcome.zero_shares, for 'subject' and then for the model as a whole with an empty scope: E7002, since the empty list of scope parts is a prefix of the other and comes first.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/1 is not in the order of check and scope.

cases.description: An available finding of tier T1 in a document whose access log has only a T0 entry: E7003. A finding of tier T1 that is not available needs no entry.

issues.message: The finding at /findings/2/tier has the tier 'T1', which no entry of the access log records.

cases.description: An entry in the mode 'planned' and an execution binding hash without /access_log/plan: E7004 at each, the access log first.

issues.message: The member at /access_log/entries/1/mode requires the plan at /access_log/plan.
The member at /inputs/execution_binding_hash requires the plan at /access_log/plan.

cases.description: The same entry and hash with /access_log/plan: no issue.
A T1 entry dated one second before the T0 entry: E7005 at its time. The T2 entry has the same time as the T1 entry, which is allowed.

issues.message: The time at /access_log/entries/1/time is earlier than the time of the entry before it.

cases.description: The basis 'disclosure_unit' in a document without a disclosure unit: E7006, naming the two values allowed.

issues.message: The basis at /findings/1/support/contributors/basis must be 'grouping_factors' or 'rows'.

cases.description: The basis 'rows' in a document with a declared disclosure unit: E7006, naming 'disclosure_unit'.
The basis 'rows' for a model with a grouping factor and no disclosure unit: the validator, which does not read the model, accepts 'grouping_factors' or 'rows', so no issue.
Five issues of stage 4 in one document, sorted by pointer: E7005 in the access log, then E7002 at /findings/1, E7006 at /findings/2, and E7001 and E7006 at /findings/3.

issues.message: The time at /access_log/entries/1/time is earlier than the time of the entry before it.
The finding at /findings/1 is not in the order of check and scope.
The basis at /findings/2/support/contributors/basis must be 'grouping_factors' or 'rows'.
The finding at /findings/3 has the same check and scope as an earlier finding.
The basis at /findings/3/support/contributors/basis must be 'grouping_factors' or 'rows'.
